samples.evidence: Release-mode Python wrappers expose locally bundled React widgets. Source maps recover all four authored frontends. CookieManager uses universal-cookie and Streamlit component messaging. Router changes session/query state. No covert endpoint, payload, credential theft or installer side effect found. GitHub UI assets fetched through a vendored license URL are separate dependencies, not wheel payloads.

All executable modules are readable. Runtime exports ApiError, MIME constants and query/parameter helpers; REST/FileService abstractions are declaration files with erased JavaScript interfaces. prepare cleans dist and compiles TypeScript. No embedded network destination or hostile code.

Manager validates origin allowlist and source membership in current iframe windows before handlers; client validates origin and window.parent. Message shapes, request IDs, timeout cleanup and listener teardown implement the documented bridge. Caller-selected wildcard origins are documented configuration, not evidence of malicious behavior.

marker_summaries: Extra Streamlit Components: fix bundled-code false matches
corrections: Generic decoder/decrypt helper references moved from objectives to neutral data/decode/custom and crypto/decrypt. Existing exact consumers updated; unreferenced triple-layer chain retired because proximity does not prove a pipeline.
writeAll helper references moved from filesystem writes to buffer transfer; disk-fill consumers keep the same matcher via the new ID.

Private handle member access moved from closed data/source/unsafe to data/property/access; zlib composite updated. Endianness field literals moved from host sysinfo to buffer integer-codec, preserving host-field composite reference sets.
Named route decorator nodes distinguish HTTP registration from Streamlit UI self.route calls.
Escaped cmd detection requires cmd.exe or cmd /c,/k syntax, excluding Arrow byte-stream cmd variables.
HDF5 filename references use extracted constants, excluding typography.h5 member access.
CVV/CVC references require complete string literals; security-field syntax excludes bare trailing commas used by source-map VLQ mappings.
Cookie path source literals require a parent path component, excluding ./Cookies imports; binary text detection retained separately. Path references carry no credential-theft ATT&CK claim.
Single-token lists exclude braces, semicolons and colons, avoiding Bootstrap CSS rows.

Custom decoder leaf population audited at 101 after additions: unreferenced +=2 token is arithmetic, not a decoder. Relocated to data/arithmetic and bounded the numeric token to exclude +=20. The leaf remains at 100 rules without a capacity-only split.

Directory-selector audit: fs/write ancestors no longer treat an arbitrary write_all helper as file output. A file-scoped, 30-line Rust file-create plus write_all composite restores evidence of filesystem output, including the disk-fill corpus control. Other ancestors intentionally require their existing filesystem observations. Cookie literals accept shell quoting after Cookies while still requiring a parent component to reject ./Cookies imports.
